name: dsh-chrome-bridge
description: DSH plugin: native browser_* tools that drive the Chrome you are already using — over native messaging + CDP. No WebSocket, no port, no Connect button. The native host and the MV3 extension ship inside this package and are installed automatically on first load; the only manual step left is picking ~/dsh-bridge-extension once at chrome://extensions (Chrome ≥137 has no programmatic extension install). Until then browser_* tools fail loudly with those exact steps.
author: OrderG-X

meta.title: Chrome Bridge
meta.description: 原生 browser_* 工具，直接操作用户正在用的 Chrome（native messaging + CDP）。宿主与扩展随包自带、首次加载自动安装，只需去 chrome://extensions 选一次 ~/dsh-bridge-extension；未加载时工具会带着这几步明确报错
